versions.purpose: extract structured candidate information from raw cv text
extract structured candidate information from raw cv text (variant: explicit worked counter-examples and a per-item evidence checklist)

a_construction.controlled_configuration_detail: same temperature, same response schema and same input variables in both arms, so the system prompt is the only variable.
a_construction.note: construction checks only. they show both prompts are structurally valid and configured identically; they say nothing about which one extracts better. run --mode live for that.

b_live_extraction_quality.reason: extraction quality can only be compared against the real api; run with --mode live and GEMINI_API_KEY set.

limitations: 3 synthetic cvs written by the author of the prompts: a comparison on covered scenarios, not a benchmark.
temperature 0.0 reduces but does not remove run-to-run variation; use --repeats to see how stable a difference is.
the grounding layer runs in both arms, so both are measured after the same safety net; the difference is in how much the net had to catch.
